summary: Tidebreak's lessons in Practice (RingLessons, LessonCard: the owner, 2026-10-05, found switching moves hard and nothing in the game taught the controls; round 2 of the skills: the same buttons for every element, LMB jab, E guard, 1 strike, 2 push, 3 dash, 4 wall, 5 heal) and a first Quick match's key hints (FirstHints). Every word here is shown to the player: no word from any show. In a line [action] is a key cap drawn from the action's binding now (InputMap: the text is right whatever the player rebound), {press} the key(s) that ready the lesson's move under the scheme, {name} its plain name, {jab} the element's jab, {grow} what fire's strike grows into, {what} and {thing} the element's words below.
_doc: lessons: in order; each {id, title, dummy (stand | throw: what the practice dummy does through it), slow (the dummy throws more slowly through it: slow_every_s between throws, its shots at slow_speed: a beginner's time to read and answer them), throws (per element: the dummy's throw through it instead of its strike, when the move exists), schemes (only under these; all when missing), elements (only for these; all when missing), per_element (its progress kept per element: its words differ), role (the move it teaches: jab, strike, push, dash, wall, heal, guard; RingLessons.role_move), by: {scheme or '*': {line, do}}}. do: walk (walk_m on foot), jab (a cast from the left button), cast (an aim cast of the role's move), quick (a cast from the left button after the bind key), guard (a guard of yours took one of its throws), return (earth: a stone caught, then thrown back), jump (a jump off the deck), knocked (the dummy pushed back a zone), out (the dummy into the water).

sounds._doc: The ring's own sounds (BendSounds ids; an Sfx id also plays) as a lesson is done and as the last is: [id, gain dB, pitch].

words.finished: That is every lesson. The dummy stays: R puts you both back, B changes what it does.

words.panel_line: Lessons: the dummy stands while you learn your buttons, then throws at you, slowly, so you can guard on the beat. Each card is done by doing it; Enter skips one; your place is kept.

earth.guard_what: it is caught and held before you
earth.dash_what: you drop into the deck and come up that way

water.guard_what: it swings round you and goes back

fire.dash_what: a hop that way; nothing held: a back-flip

air.guard_what: it bounces back, and your next hit knocks harder

*.line: Walk with [move_forward] [move_left] [move_back] [move_right]
Hold [fire]: {jab}.  Let go once its circle is full

keys.line: {press}: {name}.  Hold [aim]: aim while it fills, let go to cast.  Let go early: nothing is spent{grow}

first_moves.line: {press}: {name}.  Hold [aim]: aim while it fills, let go to cast.  Let go early: nothing is spent{grow}

direction.line: Hold [move_forward] as you press [aim]: {name}.  Let go to cast{grow}

radial.line: Hold [bend_wheel], point at {name}, let go.  Then hold [aim], let go to cast{grow}

keys.line: {press}: {name}.  Hold [aim] past the second click: ▲ it grows.  Let go to cast

first_moves.line: {press}: {name}.  Hold [aim] past the second click: ▲ it grows.  Let go to cast

direction.line: {press}: {name}.  Let go of [aim] with nothing held.  Held past the second click: ▲ it grows

radial.line: Hold [bend_wheel], point at {name}, let go.  Hold [aim] past the second click: ▲ it grows
Hold [bend_wheel], point at {name}, let go.  Then hold [aim], let go: {what}

keys.line: {press}: {name}, where you aim.  Hold [aim], let go.  Two walls each

first_moves.line: {press}: {name}, where you aim.  Hold [aim], let go.  Two walls each

direction.line: Hold [move_back] as you press [aim]: {name}, where you aim.  Two walls each

radial.line: Hold [bend_wheel], point at {name}, let go.  Hold [aim], let go: it rises where you aim

*.line: It throws {thing} now, slowly.  [bend_guard] just before one hits: {name}.  On the beat {what}
[bend_guard]: up as soon as it's ready, and it stays while you hold it.  Tap a direction to roll.  On the beat, nothing gets through
It throws stones now, slowly.  [bend_guard] just before one hits: {name}.  [bend_guard] again: throw it back
[bend_guard]: up as soon as it's ready, and it stays while you hold it.  Just before a stone hits: caught.  [bend_guard] again: throw it back
Fire along the floor? [jump]: jump it.  Through the air: dash or guard.  Rising under you: step off
[bend_quick_bind] puts the readied move on [fire].  Hold [fire], let go to cast it.  Hold [bend_quick_bind]: your jab back
{press}: {name}.  Hold [aim], let go: a little health back

radial.line: Hold [bend_wheel], point at {name}, let go.  Then hold [aim], let go: a little health back

*.line: Knock the dummy back: a hard hit pushes it back a zone at a time
Knock it off the open end into the water: that takes a round
Every hit raises the number.  The higher it is, the farther you fly
Only the water puts you out
[jump] jumps.  [jump] again in the air
[weapon_3] in the air dodges
Look at the deck, then [jump], [jump], [jump]
[move_forward] climbs, [jump] jumps, [bend_guard] rolls in, a click attacks

element_lines.earth: Jab him three times: up he goes, and you keep a stone.  Then [bend_guard]: throw it
element_lines.air: Jab him three times: up he goes.  Then hold right-click: your [weapon_2]

*.line: Jab him three times: up he goes.  Then hold right-click: your [weapon_1]
Thrown?  Hold left or right: you curve
Hit him while he climbs back.  Not while he's safe
Move with [move_forward] [move_left] [move_back] [move_right]. Aim with the mouse. Walk close to the dummy, hold [fire] and let go: {jab}
Press {press} to choose {name}. Aim at the dummy, hold right-click until its circle is full, then let go{grow}
Hold [bend_guard] for {name} to block its slow throw. Press just before it reaches you for a stronger guard
Press {press} to choose {name}. Aim at the dummy, hold right-click to charge, then release to push it into the water
Off the deck? Hold [jump] right away for help getting back. Keep holding until you land

basics_hints._doc: Round 4 SIMPLE: the hint queue's lines under the Basic controls (RingLessons, MatchSetup.basic()), over hint_queue.lines where one is here: the edge climbs by itself, Space held brings you back.
basics_hints.edge: Fall off and you grab the edge.  It climbs by itself, or press [jump] or any direction
basics_hints.recover: Off the deck? Hold [jump] right away for help getting back

_doc_basics: Round 4 SIMPLE: the Basics track (track 'basics'), five cards for the Basic controls (MatchSetup.controls() 'basic'), each done by doing it: move and jab, ready and cast (1, right-click), guard a slow throw (do 'guarded': any guard of yours that took one of its throws, on the beat or late), push it off (2 held, the dummy at 110% near an end, do 'out'), get back (you put off an end: hold Space, RingAssist brings you back, do 'back'). Under Basic the run is this track only; under Full every card but these ('schemes': ['basic'] keeps them out until RingLessons reads the track). The first launch of the game offers them once (RingAssist.offer_basics).

hints._doc: FirstHints: a first Quick match's key hints, top left, in the ring's first-time panel's place, by the control scheme; each row fades once one of its uses (actions) is pressed. On or off in the ring's Esc menu (GameSettings' hints section, key key_hints; the first Quick match that shows them turns them off as it ends).
hints.row_line: your control scheme's keys at the top left until you have used each

basic.line: Up close: hold [fire] and let go to jab
[weapon_1] strike or [weapon_2] push, then [aim] to cast
[jump]: jump · Thrown off? Hold [jump] for help

_doc_r3: Round 3, the % ring (smash_r3 spec §11.2; only under its rules, RingRules.stock_on()): rules (a lesson only under these rule sets: 'stock' the % ring, 'classic' the zones; all when missing), stock_by (its line and do under the % ring's rules, over by), element_lines (per element, over the line: the String card), dummy_pct and player_pct (each side's % as the card begins, RingRules.reset_pct), place (player_off: you put place_m out from an end and place_below_m under the lip, facing the deck; dummy_near_end: the dummy place_m in from its end), more (the three 'more' cards, after the six), do_pct (pct's goal). New do's: pct (the dummy's % at do_pct or more), out (the dummy into the water), double_jump, air_dodge (RingMoves.moved: double_jump, dodge in the air), back (you on the deck or hanging again), edge (any edge option: climb, ledge_jump, ledge_roll, ledge_attack), string (string_n true hits on the dummy: RingRules.string_hits), steer (a launch of yours steered by steer_frac of the most or more: RingRules.last_steer_deg), keep_off (the dummy, coming back from off the deck, into the water). The hint queue (hint_queue): at most one hint every gap_s, those in pre_empt always shown at once (they replace one up), those in after_fall only after the first fall; each once a match; shown show_s on the card's place.

hint_queue._doc: One hint queue in a % ring match (RingLessons.HintQueue): at most one every gap_s; pre_empt ones at once; after_fall ones only after the first fall; each once a match; thrown_mps: the throw that brings the steer hint.

lines.edge: Fall off and you grab the edge.  [move_forward] climbs, [jump] jumps, [bend_guard] rolls in, a click attacks
lines.recover: Off the deck: [jump], [jump], [jump].  Up, up, and your element lifts you
lines.steer: Thrown?  Hold left or right: you curve
lines.break_fall: [bend_guard] just as you land: back on your feet
lines.stale: The same move again and again hits softer: mix them
